notes.text: Expected outputs (True for the buggy code, False for the ConditionalWeakTable fix) are traced by reasoning, not by a real run; run-snippets must confirm them. The fix relies on the key being collected by the first full blocking GC.Collect because ConditionalWeakTable uses dependent handles that do not root the key.

ConditionalWeakTable<TKey,TValue>.AddOrUpdate and TryGetValue are assumed to exist in .NET 10 with these signatures (AddOrUpdate added in .NET Core 2.0). The constraint is assumed to allow TValue = Metadata (a class).
Claim that ConditionalWeakTable compares keys by reference identity (not Equals/GetHashCode) is from memory of the API docs remarks; verify against the ConditionalWeakTable page.

bugLineSets accepts only line 19 (the field declaration). A reviewer may argue line 21 (the store into the dictionary) is also defensible; the explanation addresses why line 21 is not the defect, but the owner may decide to accept [[21]] as well.

Determinism depends on the NoInlining helper leaving no live reference to the order in the main method; this is the same pattern as static-event-keeps-subscriber-alive, assumed to behave the same in the sandbox build configuration.
